[suggestion] `scripts/wiki-cycle-scope.py:555` and `:562` — G5/S2: the heading text `## Decisions log` is still written out in both write sites (the new-scratchpad template at 555 and the append at 562) beside the new `DECISIONS_LOG` pattern at 519, so the heading lives in three places; this is the sibling of standards-24 the fix did not cover. Quote: `text = text.rstrip("
") + "

## Decisions log
"` (562) and `f"# Cycle Run — {cycle_id[:10]}

**Status**: interrupted

## Decisions log
"` (555). Failure mode: editing the pattern at 519 alone makes the search at 563 return None and `log.end()` raise AttributeError. Fix: one `DECISIONS_HEADING = "## Decisions log"`, `DECISIONS_LOG = re.compile(rf"^{re.escape(DECISIONS_HEADING)}$", re.M)`, and the heading used in both writes.
